claims.text: Setting the PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN environment variable on the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud API service lets Terraform and OpenTofu use the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud as a state backend.
PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN is the environment variable specifying the domain that serves the Terraform-compatible API in self-hosted Pulumi Cloud.
When PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN is unset, the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud Terraform-compatible API is disabled and its routes aren't registered.
The DNS record for the PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN domain should point at the same host that serves PULUMI_API_DOMAIN.
PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN can be set to the same value as PULUMI_API_DOMAIN in self-hosted Pulumi Cloud, so a separate domain is not required.

The Pulumi state backend guide at /docs/integrations/terraform/state-backend/ uses tf.pulumi.com as the domain in Terraform/OpenTofu configuration, terraform login/tofu login, and the TF_TOKEN_* variable name.
